new.en: In Projects, you can ask to change web search and review the current and proposed choices before allowing it.
new.pt-BR: Em Projetos, você pode pedir pra mudar a busca na web e conferir a escolha atual e a nova antes de permitir.
new.es: En Proyectos, puedes pedir cambiar la búsqueda web y revisar la opción actual y la propuesta antes de permitirlo.
new.fr: Dans Projets, vous pouvez demander une modification de la recherche web et comparer les choix avant de donner votre accord.
new.de: In Projekten kannst du eine Änderung der Websuche anfragen und vor deiner Zustimmung die bisherige und die vorgeschlagene Wahl vergleichen.

decisions: | R-next | 2026-10-23 | The project agent's settings tool exposes only the closed web_search preference. Its own consent or existing full trust authorizes a typed audited change through the ordinary settings save; permissions and trust are never tool inputs. A saved tool result is queued after persistence and before stricter settings retire all replies, including the caller. | AI |
